question: For each delivery pattern, how does time to finish all intended workflows change when a finite burst grows from 10 to 100 to 1000 recipients?

state_per_cell.warmup_history: Retain the same completed 100-recipient warmup within every cell; verify that state before measurement.

primary_metric: Interval containing completion of the entire intended recipient cohort, measured from the declared release. Report all five cell intervals at each population; compare populations within each repeat and pattern.

All planned requests, correct completions, wrong transitions, untouched controls, errors and outcomes unfinished at drain
